Since it's fragrance-free, it's a total win for my sensitive skin and hasn't caused any breakouts or irritation at all. The hyaluronic acid definitely helps keep things plump and hydrated during the wash. However, if I'm being honest, it's not the best at removing heavy waterproof makeup 💄. I usually have to go in with a cleansing balm first because this cleanser alone doesn't quite get all the stubborn mascara off. Also, I noticed I have to use a couple of pumps to get a good lather going, so I might go through the bottle faster than I'd like. Overall, it's a fantastic, reliable daily cleanser for keeping your skin barrier happy, especially if you have dry or sensitive skin, but just don't expect it to be a heavy duty makeup remover! it's definitely earned a permanent spot in my morning routine though.
